tools.name: get_next_task
tools.description:
Retrieve the next priority task ordered by importance, urgency, and creation date.
Workflow:
1. If the task is BACKLOG, move it to IN_PROGRESS via update_task_status.
2. For IN_PROGRESS tasks, finish outstanding sub-tasks and mark them DONE with update_subtask_status.
3. After meeting acceptance criteria, mark the task DONE and call get_next_task again.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the MCP project root.

projectUid.description: Project UID for the connected workspace.

tools.name: update_task_status
tools.description:
Update task status (BACKLOG | IN_PROGRESS | DONE | ARCHIVED).
Before setting DONE:
- Confirm acceptance criteria or ask the user for confirmation.
- Provide completionDetails markdown with a one-line summary, '## Description', and '## Modified Files' listing exactly five 'filename: note' entries.
- Supply confidenceLevel (1-10, higher = better) and confidenceDetails covering strengths, risks, scope fit, and testing.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the MCP project root.

projectUid.description: Project UID for the connected workspace.

taskId.description: ID of the task to update status (e.g., T-001)

completionDetails.description:
Required when status is DONE. Return markdown with:
1. One-line summary of the work
2. Blank line + '## Description' detailing the implementation
3. Blank line + '## Modified Files' listing exactly five entries as 'filename: note'

confidenceLevel.description: Required when status is DONE. Integer 1-10 showing implementation quality (higher = better).

confidenceDetails.description: Required when status is DONE. Explain strengths, risks, requirement fit, and testing evidence.

tools.name: update_task_completion_log
tools.description:
Update completion details for a DONE task after additional work.
Return markdown with a combined summary, '## Description' including 'Additional work: ...', and '## Modified Files' covering every touched file.
Also provide confidenceLevel (1-10) and confidenceDetails explaining quality changes, risks, and alignment with requirements.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the MCP project root.

projectUid.description: Project UID for the connected workspace.

taskId.description: ID of the DONE task to update completion log for (e.g., T-001)

completionDetails.description: Markdown summary covering original and additional work: 1) One-line combined summary 2) Blank line + '## Description' detailing original work and 'Additional work: ...' 3) Blank line + '## Modified Files' listing every touched file as 'filename: note'.

confidenceDetails.description: Explain how the new work affected quality, risks, strengths, and alignment with requirements.
